prompt: Every cookout needs one person on the grill. Of all Americans, who gets the tongs, and why them specifically?
response: Give the tongs to George Washington. Fella held a whole army together through a winter at Valley Forge on next to nothing — he can hold a brisket at 225 without losing his nerve or lifting the lid every five minutes. Patient, don't panic, don't quit early. That's your pitmaster right there, buddy. Everybody else can go carry the plates.
